Solved T3 in one execution.

- `out/T3/solution.py` loads both input shards, casts the 112 projection matrices to bfloat16 via an anchored regex, leaves everything else float32, asserts all four required checks, then greedily packs tensors (sorted key order) into 256 MiB shards, letting the two 412 MB embedding tensors sit alone.
- Output: 10 shards + `model.safetensors.index.json` with all 114 tensors mapped; total 2,971,664,384 bytes.
- Self-report written to `out/T3/REPORT.md`.

Grading is the experimenter's step (`grade.py T3 --target olmo-1b`); I didn't run it since it lives outside the sandbox.
